In addition, this is an expansion of African sources as we rely too much on Indonesia sources and we see more and more factories being permanently shutdown in Indonesia.

At last, our strategy is to expand African supply which is more competitive than South East Asia: business case of $48/mt for African rubber versus rubber from South East Asia. Assuming a yearly volume of 5,000mt per factory, this makes a potential savings of $240k.
